summary: prospect-sequence is a runnable runx skill package that reads only explicit public allowlisted HTTPS sources, drafts a cited account-research outreach sequence, and returns a gated proposal without sending messages. Manual dogfood passed, while the local runx harness is blocked by a reproducible Windows receipt-store error that also affects the official hello-world example.

observations.result: Public URL indexing created a versioned lxx197818/prospect-sequence listing on runx.ai.
The allowlisted Runx account input exited 0 and produced research.sources, research.angle, sequence, and send_proposal.
The output cites https://runx.ai/ as the read public source for the account angle.
The loopback HTTP source exited non-zero and refused with: refused non-https source: http://127.0.0.1:3000/internal.
GitHub API verification returned success for lxx197818 starring runxhq/runx.
PR https://github.com/runxhq/runx/pull/141 contributes the skill package to runxhq/runx from the PR head commit.
runx harness skills/prospect-sequence --json failed before receipt creation with receipt store is unreadable: 参数错误。 (os error 87).
runx harness examples/hello-world --json failed with the same receipt-store error under the documented demo signing env.

dogfood.notes: The runner itself was dogfooded with a public allowlisted source and a refused private/off-policy source. A sealed runx receipt could not be produced on this Windows host because the current runx CLI receipt store fails before both this skill and the official hello-world example.
